title: 7,249 impressions, 0 clicks, one question
body: For anyone who runs SEO or content for a site or for agency clients.

title: One question, written 389 different ways
body: At the bottom of Search Console queries. The wordings read like searches an AI assistant writes.

title: Sort by clicks, scroll to the bottom
body: Open Performance, go to Queries. Sort by clicks, scroll down, read the zero-click long tail.

title: Look for one question in many wordings
body: The slow step. The sort groups zero-click rows, not meaning, so you read them yourself.

title: Impressions up, clicks flat? Check this tail
body: A rising impressions line can include searches that were never going to send a visit.

title: A pattern to watch, not proof
body: Search Console doesn't label who or what typed a query.

title: Report it as two separate lines
body: Log the cluster apart from queries real readers click. Don't strip it from the totals.

title: Check your biggest site's zero-click tail
body: Sort by clicks, read the bottom, and log any one-question cluster as its own line.
